The old stationary terminal center additionally leaves 1078 actual protein vertices outside the contracting cell field at 1.

All original folds, WD40 blades, surface resolution and seven assembled arms remain unchanged. During late remnant contraction, the existing complex center follows cytoplasm inward by the original packing interpolation, retaining the previous complex scale. Labels continue to follow their actual target meshes.
